course_review/1.summary: golfify card has holes 2-9 and 11-18 swapped and the 547-yd hole as par 4 (par 71). OSM ways and OpenGolfAPI agree on the true order (par 72, Gold 7052, Blue 6542). Only holes 1 and 10 are right on the page. Fix: rebuild with request "scorecard": "course_data/library/eagle_bend/card_fix.json" (no geometry supplement needed; OSM has 18 hole ways, 20 greens, 74 tees).
